name: Phaser 3 story kit · 2D
description: A visual novel that already plays in the browser: text, choices, several endings, a story log, auto play, skip and saves. You write the story in plain text files, and a check finds broken links and endings no one can reach.
descriptionZhCN: 已经能在浏览器里玩的视觉小说：对话、选项、多个结局、剧情回顾、自动播放、快进和存档。故事写在纯文本文件里，检查脚本会找出断开的跳转和走不到的结局。
